description: Manual override API for InfoSec analysts. FastAPI port 8786. POST /override/{server_id} with body {verdict, reason, analyst, duration_days} writes override to mcp_server_registry. GET /overrides lists active overrides. Overrides expire after duration_days. Audit logged to mcp_decisions. run() daemon.

next_directive.description: Single-page HTML status dashboard for ZO-SENTINEL. Shows: pipeline health (daemons up/down), registry stats (total MCPs, by verdict), recent threats (last 5), latest attestations, build manifest (last 10 builds). Polls /api/search, /v1/registry, /v1/threats every 30s. Dark brutalist style matching existing UI. Self-contained HTML with embedded JS.
